text:
The Supreme Court on Thursday overturned a 15-year prison sentence for former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo over his role in former President Yoon Suk Yeol's failed martial law bid, sending the case back to an appeals court for review.
The top court remanded the case to the Seoul High Court after partially finding issues with the lower ruling.
The appellate court sentenced Han to the prison term on multiple charges, including playing a key role in an insurrection in connection with Yoon's emergency decree.
The Supreme Court ruling comes about 14 months after special counsel Cho Eun-suk's team indicted the former prime minister in August last year.
